package.name: anubis_navigation
package.description: Nav2 configuration for Anubis -- tuned params.yaml (footprint, MPPI controller, costmap self-filtering) on top of unmodified, apt-installed Nav2 (ros-humble-navigation2 + ros-humble-nav2-bringup). Contains no Nav2 source of its own: darmawan_ws's 14 forked Nav2 packages (navigo_bt_navigator, navigo_costmap_2d, etc.) turned out to be unmodified renamed copies of upstream Nav2, so there was nothing in the fork worth preserving -- only the tuned params.yaml this package carries. See README.md.
